**Finding: Deviation (high) — Section 15, Assignment or Transfer (p0080)**

What I found:
- Section 15 is the only assignment provision; there is no change-of-control language anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "assign" and "change of control" returned only this clause).
- The mutual prohibition on assignment carves out only "an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate" — there is **no M&A/successor carve-out** for Mortgage Logic, the consent standard is **unqualified** (TrueLink could refuse arbitrarily), and nothing stops TrueLink from assigning the hosting relationship to one of our competitors.
- Mitigating: the restriction is symmetric and TrueLink has **no** express termination or re-pricing right on our change of control, so this is not a walk-away.

Redline submitted (validated ok:true), preferred level, one surgical replacement in p0080: reasonable-consent standard, Client affiliate/successor carve-out for merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of substantially all assets, bar on TrueLink assigning to a Client competitor, and a confirmation that a Client change of control is neither an assignment nor a TrueLink termination/suspension/re-pricing trigger. The comment offers the mutual successor-with-notice fallback if TrueLink pushes back on asymmetry.
